chmod[[:space:]]+(-R[[:space:]]+)?0?777([[:space:]]|$)	world-writable permissions
chmod[[:space:]]+(-R[[:space:]]+)?a\+w([[:space:]]|$)	world-writable permissions
bash[[:space:]]+<\([[:space:]]*(curl|wget)	remote script run via process substitution — fetch, verify, then execute instead
sh[[:space:]]+-c[[:space:]]+"\$\((curl|wget|fetch)	remote script run via command substitution — fetch, verify, then execute instead
(curl|wget)[^|]*\|[[:space:]]*env[[:space:]]+[^|]*[[:space:]](ba)?sh([[:space:]]|$)	remote script piped into a shell via env — fetch, verify, then execute instead
--allow-unsigned-rpm	package signature check disabled
--nogpgcheck	package signature check disabled
--gpg-auto-import-keys	repository signing keys trusted without verification
curl[[:space:]]+(-[a-zA-Z]*k([[:space:]]|$)|--insecure)	TLS certificate verification disabled
